Class OfferTiles

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.it.tiles.OfferTiles
public class OfferTiles extends Object
The Offer Track: the ordered sequence of active offer tiles for a given game. During setup, tiles are filtered by player count and ordered by letter (A–G). - Track which tiles are free or occupied - Return the list of free tiles for totem placement - Return the tile occupied by a given totem colour

    • placeTotem

      public void placeTotem(Player player, OfferTile tile)
      Places the player's totem on the chosen tile. player=the player placing their totem tile=the chosen tile (must be free and belong to this track) IllegalArgumentException if the tile does not belong to this track IllegalStateException if the tile is already occupied
